task_completion.description: Launch CoppeliaSim and load the Pioneer P3DX robot model.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The CoppeliaSim GUI is visible with a Pioneer P3DX robot present in the 3D scene.

task_completion.description: The robot executes a multi-segment trajectory involving both translation and rotation.
task_completion.visual_evidence: Screenshots show the robot in different positions and orientations over time, indicating movement.

task_completion.description: The simulation runs for at least 10 seconds while collecting data.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The simulation clock in the CoppeliaSim status bar or a terminal log shows a elapsed time of >= 10 seconds.

task_completion.description: Save the time-series data to /home/ga/Documents/CoppeliaSim/exports/odometry_track.csv with required columns.
task_completion.visual_evidence: A file explorer or terminal 'ls' command shows odometry_track.csv exists in the specified path; a 'cat' or 'head' command shows columns: odom_x, odom_y, true_x, true_y, error_m.
A file explorer or terminal shows odometry_summary.json exists in the specified path.

task_completion.description: The recorded data covers at least 1.0m of translation and 1.0rad of rotation.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The contents of the CSV or JSON file show values for translation (change in x/y) >= 1.0m and rotation (change in orientation) >= 1.0rad.

integrity.description: The agent interacted with the CoppeliaSim environment rather than just creating dummy files.
integrity.visual_evidence: Screenshots show the CoppeliaSim play button active and the robot physically moving in the viewport.

integrity.description: The agent did not manually type the CSV/JSON content with arbitrary numbers.
integrity.visual_evidence: The agent is seen writing or running a script (Python/Lua) that interfaces with the CoppeliaSim API (Remote API or BlueZero) to fetch real-time coordinates.

integrity.description: The agent operated under the 'ga' user account as specified.
integrity.visual_evidence: Terminal prompts show 'ga@' or file paths include '/home/ga/'.

privileged_info_for_vlm: The task requires a minimum of 1.0m translation and 1.0rad rotation over at least 10 seconds. The output files must be located at /home/ga/Documents/CoppeliaSim/exports/odometry_track.csv (containing odom_x, odom_y, true_x, true_y, error_m) and /home/ga/Documents/CoppeliaSim/exports/odometry_summary.json. The robot used must be a Pioneer P3DX.
